page: Microsoft Azure NC64as_T4_v3 is a virtual machine instance within the NCASv3_T4 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It is powered by dedicated AMD processors utilizing the x86_64 architecture and provides 64 dedicated vCPUs. The instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The hardware configuration includes 440.0 GB of system memory, which provides 6.88 GB of RAM per core. For parallel processing and graphics acceleration, the server is equipped with four NVIDIA T4 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 60 GB of VRAM. Local storage consists of a 2884 GB SSD, and the instance is Premium Storage capable.

This resource profile is designed for workloads requiring multi-GPU acceleration alongside substantial system memory and local storage. The combination of 64 dedicated vCPUs and four NVIDIA T4 GPUs makes this instance suitable for machine learning inference, data science jobs, and database operations that benefit from local SSD storage.
